I often forget important PySpark functions!

So, here’s a chessboard featuring the most common ones.

I made a simple chessboard-style visual to help you remember the most common PySpark functions - right when you need them.

You can use this chessboard as a quick cheat sheet. Pull it up when you are coding in Databricks or any PySpark notebook.

Which PySpark function do you use most? Or is there a “hidden gem” you think should be on the chessboard?
